answer: In PoA, each challenge commits to a future drand quicknet pulse whose threshold-BLS signature is unpredictable and unbiasable until a quorum produces it. Even an umber ridge island of sybils must await each beacon, while commit-reveal binds submissions before revelation and exposes equivocation.
